title: ASI Solutions acquires managed security provider Insicon Cyber
date_note: ARN's article of 24 November gives no earlier date for the deal; the publication day is used.
geo_basis: Insicon Cyber's office and security operations centre in North Sydney, per ARN
summary: ARN reports that ASI Solutions has acquired Insicon Cyber, a managed security service provider operating in Australia and New Zealand. Insicon keeps its own brand and is now an ASI Solutions company; ARN says the deal value was not disclosed. ARN says ASI has completed six acquisitions in seven years.
plain: ASI Solutions has bought Insicon Cyber, a managed security provider in Australia and New Zealand. The price was not disclosed.
exec: ASI Solutions is expanding into managed security services by buying Insicon Cyber, per ARN.

validation.note: ARN read; reseller.co.nz carries the same headline but was not read; MSSP Alert returned 403.
